title: Examining the Interplay Between Privacy and Fairness for Speech Processing: A Review and Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Literature review and conceptual analysis of representation bias and algorithmic performance disparities in speech processing datasets and models.
Literature review examining mis-detection, aggregation bias, and fairness-privacy tradeoffs for speakers with non-normative accents and dialects.
Reviewing measurement bias in speech datasets (e.g., the VoxCeleb dataset) where nationality is used as a proxy label, conflating it with accent and dialect.
Conceptual analysis of the impact of sensitive attribute consolidation on fairness, specifically evaluating the underperformance of models on individuals outside normative age groups.
Literature review discussing biases and privacy risks in speech-centric models diagnosing medical or mental health conditions (e.g., depression assessment).
